steps.title: Capability-constrained route
steps.summary: The managed Mock main agent is eligible; opaque or uncertified candidates are excluded with stable reason codes.

steps.title: Heterogeneous read-only review
steps.summary: A fingerprint-distinct Replay reviewer checks a frozen patch and test snapshot without write access.

steps.title: Durable recovery
steps.summary: A safe checkpoint is reclaimed after a simulated daemon interruption while the fencing token rejects the stale worker.

steps.title: Opaque effects need a human decision
steps.summary: An interrupted opaque attempt is marked reconciliation_required and is never silently replayed.

steps.title: Offline signed delivery
steps.summary: The final projection binds route, review, tests, Evidence and artifact hashes; an in-memory tamper demonstration fails verification.
